theorem ramp_product_sub_strict_indicator_le_strip_union {ι : Type*}

    (∏ i ∈ I, ramp i) - (if ∀ i ∈ I, 0 < G i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤

headers.name: finiteSourceMass_ramp_product_le_strict_card_add_strip_cards
headers.header:
theorem finiteSourceMass_ramp_product_le_strict_card_add_strip_cards {ι : Type*}
    (I : Finset ι) (S : Finset ℕ) (G ramp : ι → ℕ → ℝ) (width : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ m ∈ S, ∀ i ∈ I, 0 ≤ ramp i m ∧ ramp i m ≤ 1)
    (hone : ∀ m ∈ S, ∀ i ∈ I, 0 < G i m → ramp i m = 1)
    (hzero : ∀ m ∈ S, ∀ i ∈ I, G i m ≤ -width → ramp i m = 0) :
    finiteSourceMass S (fun m => ∏ i ∈ I, ramp i m) ≤
      (((S.filter (fun m => ∀ i ∈ I, 0 < G i m)).card : ℕ) : ℝ) +
        ∑ i ∈ I, (((S.filter
          (fun m => -width < G i m ∧ G i m ≤ 0)).card : ℕ) : ℝ) :=

headers.name: finiteSourceMass_ramp_product_surplus_paid
headers.header:
theorem finiteSourceMass_ramp_product_surplus_paid {ι : Type*}
    (I : Finset ι) (S A : Finset ℕ) (G ramp : ι → ℕ → ℝ) (width E : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ m ∈ S, ∀ i ∈ I, 0 ≤ ramp i m ∧ ramp i m ≤ 1)
    (hone : ∀ m ∈ S, ∀ i ∈ I, 0 < G i m → ramp i m = 1)
    (hzero : ∀ m ∈ S, ∀ i ∈ I, G i m ≤ -width → ramp i m = 0)
    (hsource : S.filter (fun m => ∀ i ∈ I, 0 < G i m) = A)
    (hpaid : (∑ i ∈ I, (((S.filter
      (fun m => -width < G i m ∧ G i m ≤ 0)).card : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ E) :
    finiteSourceMass S (fun m => ∏ i ∈ I, ramp i m) ≤ (A.card : ℝ) + E :=

headers.name: eventually_realSource_ramp_surplus_paid
headers.header:
theorem eventually_realSource_ramp_surplus_paid {ι : Type*}
    (b kappa : ℝ) (I : ℝ → ℕ → Finset ι) (S : ℝ → ℕ → Finset ℕ)
    (G ramp : ℝ → ℕ → ι → ℕ → ℝ) (width : ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hramp : ∀ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta → ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, Even N →
      ∀ m ∈ S delta N, ∀ i ∈ I delta N,
        (0 ≤ ramp delta N i m ∧ ramp delta N i m ≤ 1) ∧
        (0 < G delta N i m → ramp delta N i m = 1) ∧
        (G delta N i m ≤ -width delta N → ramp delta N i m = 0))
    (hsource : ∀ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta → ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, Even N →
      (S delta N).filter (fun m => ∀ i ∈ I delta N, 0 < G delta N i m) =
        realHalfProductSource b N (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappa N))
    (hpaid : ∀ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta → ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, Even N →
      (∑ i ∈ I delta N, ((((S delta N).filter
        (fun m => -width delta N < G delta N i m ∧ G delta N i m ≤ 0)).card : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
        delta * ((N : ℝ) / Real.log (N : ℝ))) :
    ∀ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta → ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, Even N →
      finiteSourceMass (S delta N)
        (fun m => ∏ i ∈ I delta N, ramp delta N i m) ≤
        ((realHalfProductSource b N (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappa N)).card : ℝ) +
          delta * ((N : ℝ) / Real.log (N : ℝ)) :=

headers.name: logGateOuterRamp_product_surplus_le_strip_union
headers.header:
theorem logGateOuterRamp_product_surplus_le_strip_union {ι : Type*}
    (I : Finset ι) (G : ι → ℝ) {width : ℝ} (hwidth : 0 < width) :
    (∏ i ∈ I, logGateOuterRamp width (G i)) -
      (if ∀ i ∈ I, 0 < G i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
        ∑ i ∈ I, if -width < G i ∧ G i ≤ 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0 :=

headers.name: finiteSourceMass_logGateOuterRamp_surplus_paid
headers.header:
theorem finiteSourceMass_logGateOuterRamp_surplus_paid {ι : Type*}
    (I : Finset ι) (S A : Finset ℕ) (G : ι → ℕ → ℝ)
    {width : ℝ} (hwidth : 0 < width) (E : ℝ)
    (hsource : S.filter (fun m => ∀ i ∈ I, 0 < G i m) = A)
    (hpaid : (∑ i ∈ I, (((S.filter
      (fun m => -width < G i m ∧ G i m ≤ 0)).card : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ E) :
    finiteSourceMass S (fun m => ∏ i ∈ I, logGateOuterRamp width (G i m)) ≤
      (A.card : ℝ) + E :=

headers.name: p1_normalized_closedUpper_initial
headers.header:
theorem p1_normalized_closedUpper_initial
    (beta u : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) (hbeta : 0 < beta) (hbetaU : beta ≤ 2 * u) :
    (2 * Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / u) *

headers.name: exists_p1_actualSmallRosserPlusDensity_cube_compact_normalized_threshold
headers.header:
theorem exists_p1_actualSmallRosserPlusDensity_cube_compact_normalized_threshold
    (T : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hT : IsCompact T)
    (hparam : ∀ p ∈ T, 0 < p.2 ∧ 0 < p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ 3 * p.2)
    (eta : ℝ) (heta : 0 < eta) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, 2 ≤ N0 ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, N0 ≤ N → Even N →
      ∀ p ∈ T, ∀ cap : ℕ, (N : ℝ) ^ p.2 ≤ (cap : ℝ) →
        |actualSmallRosserPlusDensity N cap ((N : ℝ) ^ p.2) ((N : ℝ) ^ p.1) *
            Real.log (N : ℝ) / singularSeries N - 4 / p.1| < eta :=

headers.name: exists_p1_actualSmallRosserPlusDensity_closed_residual_compact_normalized_threshold
headers.header:
theorem exists_p1_actualSmallRosserPlusDensity_closed_residual_compact_normalized_threshold
    (T : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hT : IsCompact T)
    (hparam : ∀ p ∈ T, 0 < p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ p.1)
    (eta : ℝ) (heta : 0 < eta) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, 2 ≤ N0 ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, N0 ≤ N → Even N →
      ∀ p ∈ T, ∀ cap : ℕ, (N : ℝ) ^ p.2 ≤ (cap : ℝ) →
        |actualSmallRosserPlusDensity N cap ((N : ℝ) ^ p.2) ((N : ℝ) ^ p.1) *
            Real.log (N : ℝ) / singularSeries N -
          (2 * Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / p.2) *
            P1FourthNearOneKernel.closedUpper (p.1 / p.2)| < eta :=

headers.name: exists_p1_actualSmallRosserPlusDensity_closed_compact_normalized_threshold
headers.header:
theorem exists_p1_actualSmallRosserPlusDensity_closed_compact_normalized_threshold
    (S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (hparam : ∀ p ∈ S, 0 < p.1 ∧ 1 ≤ p.2)
    (eta : ℝ) (heta : 0 < eta) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, 2 ≤ N0 ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, N0 ≤ N → Even N →
      ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ cap : ℕ, (N : ℝ) ^ p.1 ≤ (cap : ℝ) →
        |actualSmallRosserPlusDensity N cap ((N : ℝ) ^ p.1)
            ((N : ℝ) ^ (p.2 * p.1)) * Real.log (N : ℝ) / singularSeries N -
          (2 * Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / p.1) *
            P1FourthNearOneKernel.closedUpper p.2| < eta :=

headers.name: tendstoUniformlyOn_p1_actualSmallRosserPlusDensity_closed_normalized
headers.header:
theorem tendstoUniformlyOn_p1_actualSmallRosserPlusDensity_closed_normalized
    (S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (hparam : ∀ p ∈ S, 0 < p.1 ∧ 1 ≤ p.2)
    (cap : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ → ℕ)
    (hcap : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop ⊓ Filter.principal {N : ℕ | 0 < N ∧ Even N},
      ∀ p ∈ S, (N : ℝ) ^ p.1 ≤ (cap N p : ℝ)) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun N p => actualSmallRosserPlusDensity N (cap N p) ((N : ℝ) ^ p.1)
        ((N : ℝ) ^ (p.2 * p.1)) * Real.log (N : ℝ) / singularSeries N)
      (fun p => (2 * Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / p.1) *
        P1FourthNearOneKernel.closedUpper p.2)
      (atTop ⊓ Filter.principal {N : ℕ | 0 < N ∧ Even N}) S :=

headers.name: exists_p1_actualSmallRosserPlusDensity_closed_quotient_compact_normalized_threshold
headers.header:
theorem exists_p1_actualSmallRosserPlusDensity_closed_quotient_compact_normalized_threshold
    (T : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hT : IsCompact T)
    (hparam : ∀ p ∈ T, 0 < p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ p.1)
    (eta : ℝ) (heta : 0 < eta) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, 2 ≤ N0 ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, N0 ≤ N → Even N →
      ∀ P y lambda : ℝ, 0 < P → 0 < y →
        actualRosserQuotientParameters (N : ℝ) P y lambda ∈ T →
        ∀ cap : ℕ, y ≤ (cap : ℝ) →
          |actualSmallRosserPlusDensity N cap y ((N : ℝ) ^ lambda / P) *
              Real.log (N : ℝ) / singularSeries N -
            (2 * Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) /
                (actualRosserQuotientParameters (N : ℝ) P y lambda).2) *
              P1FourthNearOneKernel.closedUpper
                ((actualRosserQuotientParameters (N : ℝ) P y lambda).1 /
                  (actualRosserQuotientParameters (N : ℝ) P y lambda).2)| < eta :=

definitions.name: jointCell
definitions.raw:
def jointCell (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (j : Fin 4 → Fin (D.m + 1)) :
    Set (Fin 4 → ℝ) :=
  logPrimeMeshCell (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) D.m j ∩
    primeAffineGateRegion p1_fourthParentGateForms (D.p1_fourthParentGateBounds j)

definitions.name: extendedProfile
definitions.raw:
def extendedProfile (lambda : ℝ) (t : Fin 4 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 * Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant)) * maxOneNormalized lambda t

definitions.name: reciprocalWeight
definitions.raw: def reciprocalWeight (t : Fin 4 → ℝ) : ℝ := ∏ i, 1 / t i

definitions.name: extendedWeightedProfile
fullCellIntegral
definitions.raw:
def fullCellIntegral (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (j : Fin 4 → Fin (D.m + 1)) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t in jointCell D j,
    (extendedProfile (D.old4 j : ℝ) t - extendedProfile (D.cap4 j : ℝ) t) *
      reciprocalWeight t

definitions.name: fullIntegral
definitions.raw:
def fullIntegral (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j ∈ D.cells4, fullCellIntegral D j
